A few helpful answers

Before you
settle into the chair.

If your question is a little more personal, a message is a good place to start.

Text MJ ↗
What should I book for my first visit?

If you know the service you want, choose it from the booking menu. For a color change, extensions or uncertainty about appointment length, text MJ before choosing. The menu includes color correction and extensions consultations.

Do you offer consultations?

The menu lists a complimentary 10 minute color correction consultation and a complimentary 15 minute extensions consultation. A bridal hair consultation is $80 for 90 minutes. Select the matching service in the booking menu.

Where do I see prices and available times?

Service prices and listed lengths are shown here. The booking menu has the current availability and complete service combinations. Confirm the price, service details and any policy before completing your booking.

Can I ask about curls, texture or previous color?

Absolutely. Describe your hair and what you want to change. Share your recent color or treatment history so MJ can help you choose the right appointment.

How do I reschedule or check cancellation terms?

Use the information in your booking confirmation, or contact MJ directly. Confirm cancellation, deposit and rescheduling terms in the booking menu before reserving your time.

Can I give someone a gift?

MJ’s existing gift card page is linked below. Follow it to check the available options and complete your purchase.
